questions.q: Where should you check for the current CSA exam's time limit, question count, and passing score, per this lesson?
options: ServiceNow's own current certification page and exam blueprint, since those details change across releases
This lesson, which states the exact current numbers
Any third-party exam dump site
The Platform Fundamentals course outline
questions.explain: This lesson deliberately avoids stating specific exam-format numbers because they can change release to release and are easy to misremember.

questions.q: Which course and chapter map most directly to the exam's User Administration domain?
options: Platform Fundamentals Chapter 3
This course's own Chapter 1 — Creating & Managing Users, Groups, Roles, and Delegated Administration
Platform Fundamentals Chapter 7
This course's Chapter 4
questions.explain: Chapter 1 of this course (Lessons 1-4) covers users, groups, roles, and delegated administration directly.

questions.q: The exam's Database Administration domain, covering tables and the dictionary, maps to which lessons?
options: This course's Chapter 4 on notifications
This course's Chapter 2 on ACLs
Platform Fundamentals Chapter 3 (Tables & Relationships) and Chapter 4 (Dictionary Entries & Field Types)
Platform Fundamentals Chapter 1
questions.explain: Table structure, extension, and the Task hierarchy live in Platform Fundamentals Chapter 3; field types and the dictionary live in Chapter 4.

questions.q: Why does this lesson flag the UI-policy-vs-data-policy comparison (Lesson 22) as a favorite exam scenario setup?
options: Because UI Policies and Data Policies are identical and interchangeable
Because a UI Policy only hides a field client-side and provides no real enforcement against something like an Import Set writing to that field directly
Because the exam never tests this distinction
Because Data Policies replaced UI Policies in a recent release
questions.explain: A client-side-only UI Policy doesn't stop a backend process like an Import Set from writing an invalid value — that gap is exactly what Data Policies exist to close.

questions.q: What is this lesson's main purpose, as stated in its opening section?
options: To teach brand-new ServiceNow concepts not covered anywhere else in the path
To act as a map, pointing each real CSA exam domain back to the specific lesson in course 2 or course 3 that already taught it
To replace the need for reviewing any earlier lesson
To introduce the capstone project's technical requirements
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly says it teaches nothing new — it maps exam domains to lessons you've already completed so review time is targeted.
